description: This file defines the NumberFormat class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages number formatting styles, including predefined format constants, applying formats, and handling built-in format codes.

classes.name: NumberFormat
classes.description: Handles Excel number formats, providing constants for common formats, applying formats, and managing built-in format codes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a NumberFormat object, potentially as a supervisor or conditional style.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Returns the shared style component for the current cell.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds a style array from subcomponents.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style settings from an array to the number format.

methods.name: setFormatCode
methods.description: Sets the format code, either a predefined constant or custom format string.

methods.name: getBuiltInFormatCode
methods.description: Gets the built-in format code index.

methods.name: setBuiltInFormatCode
methods.description: Sets the built-in format code by index.

methods.name: fillBuiltInFormatCodes
methods.description: Fills the lookup arrays for built-in format codes and their indexes.

methods.name: builtInFormatCode
methods.description: Retrieves the format string for a built-in format code index.

methods.name: builtInFormatCodeIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the index for a given format string if it's a built-in format.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the style object.

methods.name: toFormattedString
methods.description: Formats a value according to a predefined or custom number format.

methods.name: exportArray1
methods.description: Exports style data as an array for serialization or storage.
